question: For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month.
sql:
WITH month_pairs AS (
    SELECT '2020-02' as output_month, '2020-01-31' as prev_month_end
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03', '2020-02-29'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04', '2020-03-31'
),
balance_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.output_month,
        mp.prev_month_end,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount 
                 WHEN ct.txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -ct.txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) as balance
    FROM month_pairs mp
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct ON ct.txn_date <= mp.prev_month_end
    GROUP BY mp.output_month, mp.prev_month_end
)
SELECT output_month, 
       CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END as final_balance
FROM balance_calc
ORDER BY output_month
